node.statement: Using node 1.1 and the two hypotheses ||Delta Upsilon-Phi||_cb<=epsilon and ||Upsilon Delta-I_B||_cb<=epsilon, write Phi Delta-Delta=(Phi-Delta Upsilon)Delta+Delta(Upsilon Delta-I_B). Complete contractivity of Delta and submultiplicativity of cb norm give ||Phi Delta-Delta||_cb<=epsilon+epsilon=2*epsilon.
